verification_policy: Single-skill acquisition and mechanics research: reconcile the explicit Xenoverse 2 PQ reward record with independent skill documentation, preserve RNG uncertainty, and do not promote community farming conditions to mandatory Ultimate Finish requirements without direct evidence.
research_scope: Big Bang Knuckle — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics; PQ172 gap coverage.

verification_audit.method: Compared the repository's existing PQ163-177 and PQ151-162 research batches with the current Xenoverse 2 skill record, official Dragon Ball documentation, and independent acquisition/player reports.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing research commit for Big Bang Knuckle was found. The existing seeded skills index contains the Strike Super identity, while the prior PQ163-177 batch skipped the PQ172 reward record; this batch fills that research gap without creating a second canonical identity.

verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Big Bang Knuckle is a Strike Super obtained from Parallel Quest 172 — Little Big Brother. The current dedicated skill record and independent Xenoverse 2 documentation agree on the PQ172 route. Community reports confirm the skill is a random PQ reward, but the reviewed evidence does not establish a mandatory Ultimate Finish condition for the skill itself.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The move fires a sequence of Ki Blast projectiles and, when the attack connects, chases the opponent and finishes with an aura-infused punch. The dedicated skill documentation describes up to seven initial Ki Blasts followed by the chase/punch sequence and notes that it can immediately transition into Final Rampage.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed sources establish PQ172 acquisition and RNG behavior but do not independently establish that the Ultimate Finish is mandatory for Big Bang Knuckle.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed sources do not establish a canonical stamina value.

records.name: Big Bang Knuckle
records.character_source: Vegeta (Super Saiyan God) Ultra Supervillain / Vegeta customizable partners / Vegeta (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A Strike Super that launches a flurry of Ki Blasts; on a successful hit, the user chases the opponent and follows with an aura-infused punch.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill documentation describes up to seven initial Ki Blasts followed by a chase sequence and finishing punch. The move is a mixed-looking projectile/chase attack but is classified as Strike in the Xenoverse 2 skill data. It can immediately follow into Final Rampage according to the dedicated skill reference.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ172 is the documented source. Community acquisition reports describe the skill as an RNG drop and recommend specific performance conditions for farming, but those recommendations are not encoded as mandatory unlock requirements here.
records.pve_notes: PQ172 farming is required for the documented acquisition route; exact drop probability is unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Current player discussions describe useful tracking and post-knockback applications, but matchup/frame-data claims remain version-sensitive and are not treated as canonical mechanics.
